name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea tests cluster-warhead cruise missiles; denies Binance theft
state: North Korea test-fired strategic cruise missiles with a new cluster-munition warhead on 2 Nov, KCNA said, after a reported launch on 1 Nov and a ballistic test on 31 Oct (Euronews). Kim Yo Jong called the FBI's Binance theft finding 'absurd' (RTÉ). No nuclear test or ICBM launch has been reported.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for South Korea and Japan; daily life there is unaffected.
